name: cashloom-sovereign

scripts.build:ui: cd ui && bun install && bun run build
scripts.test: bun run test:covenant-draft && bunx vitest run src/connectors src/utils src/info && bun run test:node && bun test src/index.test.ts && bun test src/wallet && bun test src/pay/agent-pay.test.ts
scripts.test:connectors: bunx vitest run src/connectors src/utils src/info
scripts.test:node: bun test src/vault.test.ts src/sync.test.ts src/pay.test.ts src/senders/btc.sender.test.ts src/senders/evm.sender.test.ts src/zerone.test.ts
scripts.test:wallet: bun test src/wallet && bun test src/pay/agent-pay.test.ts
